questions.text: Consider the following code snippet [IMAGE: /data/images/cs4022_2026T1_ET_AN_p7_Im1.webp|block] Which of the following statements is correct?
options: The program creates three threads, each printing "Operating Systems" 50 times, and "Done" is printed only after all thread outputs are completed.
The program creates three threads, each printing "Operating Systems" 50 times, but "Done" may appear before some thread outputs.
The program creates one thread at a time due to pthread join, resulting in sequential execution.
The program prints "Operating Systems" exactly 50 times in total and then prints "Done".

questions.text: Consider the following processes in an xv6-like operating system: • Process P1 is waiting in the ready queue. • Process P2 is currently executing on the CPU. • Process P3 is blocked waiting for disk I/O. • Process P4 has terminated, but its parent has not yet called wait().
options: P1 is in the RUNNABLE state.
P2 is in the RUNNING state.
P3 is in the SLEEPING state.
P4 is in the ZOMBIE state.
P3 is in the RUNNABLE state.
P4 is in the RUNNING state.
correct_answer: P1 is in the RUNNABLE state.
P2 is in the RUNNING state.
P3 is in the SLEEPING state.
P4 is in the ZOMBIE state.

options: gcc file1.c file2.c -o output produces an executable named output.
